All Basic SW Modules shall be documented according to a common
standard.

human beings

The Implementation of interrupt service routines shall be done by the

All AUTOSAR Basic Software Modules shall provide configuration rules and
constraints to enable plausibility checks

SW components shall be tested by a function defined in a common API in
the Basis-SW

The AUTOSAR SW Components shall provide information about their
dependency from faults, signal qualities, driver demands

Optional functionality of a Basic-SW component that is not required in the
ECU shall be configurable at pre-compile-time

The scheduling strategy that is built inside the Basic Software Modules shall
be compatible with the strategy used in the system
